templates.name: Contract Review — Obligations Register
templates.one_liner: Extracts and structures what a contract SAYS: parties, deliverables, obligations with verbatim clause citations, deadlines, penalties, an….
templates.description: Extracts and structures what a contract SAYS: parties, deliverables, obligations with verbatim clause citations, deadlines, penalties, and ambiguity gaps. The engine in reverse — the contract is the source; the deliverable is understanding. HARD BOUNDARY: extracts and traces, never interprets or advises. Legal evaluation rests with the reader and their counsel, stated in the declaration.

templates.name: Design Basis

templates.description: Establishes the inputs, codes, loads, materials, and assumptions governing a structural or mechanical design. Compiled from client specifications, standards, environmental/geotechnical reports, and decision records. Structure aligned with NORSOK N-001 / Eurocode project practice. The engine compiles and traces — engineering responsibility rests with the signing engineer.

templates.name: Thesis Evidence Draft — Materials Science
templates.one_liner: Compiles the EVIDENCE backbone of a materials-science thesis: materials, methods, per-experiment result chapters, characterization data, ….
templates.description: Compiles the EVIDENCE backbone of a materials-science thesis: materials, methods, per-experiment result chapters, characterization data, nomenclature — with full claim-to-source traceability. Interpretation, contribution and discussion are generated as structured scaffolds with [AUTHOR] placeholders: the argument is the researcher's. Demonstrates grammar v2: hierarchy (parent_key), repetition (repeat_for), auto-numbering, symbol registry, equation/figure blocks.

templates.name: Project Plan
templates.one_liner: Phased project plan compiled from the project memory: phases and activities drafted by AI from the artifact model and indexed material (c….
templates.description: Phased project plan compiled from the project memory: phases and activities drafted by AI from the artifact model and indexed material (clearly AI-proposed, user-owned), while every date, deadline, dimension and document reference is a cited fact or [MANGLER]. Known issues (rev conflicts, open TQs, hazards) are pulled from the index as risk items. Sequencing and priorities are planning judgment — author placeholders mark where the human decides.

templates.description: For multi-standard design specifications (client spec + NORSOK/ISO/EN/class invocations). Extracts every requirement with a subject key, groups by subject across all provided documents, and detects: conflicts (same subject, incompatible values — both clauses cited), redundancies (most stringent noted), missing precedence order, and invoked-but-not-provided documents. Serves BOTH sides: the receiving engineer gets a ready-to-send technical query list; the issuing company runs it on drafts before

templates.name: Structural Design Report
templates.one_liner: Documents that a design satisfies its design basis: model, loads applied, governing checks, utilizations, deviations.
templates.description: Documents that a design satisfies its design basis: model, loads applied, governing checks, utilizations, deviations. Compiled from calc sheets, FEA result tables, drawings and the design basis. The engine compiles and traces results — it does not verify calculations. Engineering verification and responsibility rest with the signing engineer.

templates.name: Technical Documentation Package
templates.one_liner: Combined user manual, operational guide and service documentation for a physical product, tool or machine.
templates.description: Combined user manual, operational guide and service documentation for a physical product, tool or machine. Structure aligned with EN 82079-1 (preparation of instructions for use) and Machinery Directive Annex I 1.7.4 information requirements.

templates.name: Tender Compliance Matrix & Response Skeleton
templates.one_liner: Two-corpus compilation: extracts every requirement from tender documents (fact_type='requirement', one row each, clause-cited), then maps….
templates.description: Two-corpus compilation: extracts every requirement from tender documents (fact_type='requirement', one row each, clause-cited), then maps the company's own material (past project docs, certificates, CVs, procedures) against each requirement — coverage where evidence exists, blocking gaps where it does not. Uses grammar v2 repeat_for to instantiate one response block per requirement. This is the requirements traceability matrix EPC teams build by hand over weeks.

templates.name: Topic Brief — Cited Engineering Pack
templates.one_liner: NotebookLM-style topic pack from a source library: zones, cable classes, earthing, separation, standards.
templates.description: NotebookLM-style topic pack from a source library: zones, cable classes, earthing, separation, standards. Every claim cites a file. MANGLER only where the corpus is silent. Not a research report; not a fact wall.

templates.name: User Manual
templates.one_liner: Instructions for use (brukermanual / bruksanvisning) for a product, tool or machine.
templates.description: Instructions for use (brukermanual / bruksanvisning) for a product, tool or machine. Structure aligned with EN 82079-1 — identification, intended use, safety, operation, maintenance, troubleshooting. Distinct from the broader technical documentation package and from installation manuals.

privacy: Filene dine ligger på din maskin. Foldok laster dem aldri opp til noen Foldok-sky og lagrer ingen kopier hos oss.
Når jeg analyserer en fil, sendes utdrag av innholdet (tekst eller bilde) til AI-tjenesten for behandling av akkurat det kallet — du ser kostnaden i €-måleren. Originalene blir hvor de er.
Ferdige og signerte PDF-er lagres heller ikke hos oss — de er dine.
privacy_en: Your files stay on your machine. Foldok never uploads them to a Foldok cloud or keeps copies on our side.
When I analyse a file, excerpts (text or image) are sent to the AI service for that call only — you see the cost in the € meter. The originals stay put.
Finished and signed PDFs are not stored with us either — they are yours.

legal_framing.en: Foldok does document review and extraction: parties, obligations, deadlines and penalties with verbatim clause citations, plus cross-document conflict detection. It records what the documents say and what could not be found. It is not legal advice, and the legal assessment stays with you.
legal_framing.no: Foldok gjør dokumentgjennomgang og ekstraksjon: parter, forpliktelser, frister og sanksjoner med ordrette klausulsitater, pluss konfliktdeteksjon på tvers av dokumenter. Den registrerer hva dokumentene sier og hva som ikke ble funnet. Det er ikke juridisk råd — den juridiske vurderingen er din.
